name: Futanari Idol ~Shuuchi Training Nikki~
original_name: ふたなりアイドル　～羞恥トレーニング日記～
source:
The story of what a girl with a penis endures on the road to fame.
Dance lessons, posturing, health checks... watch her grow and change
as she does naked activities and pees during them.
As a futa she has an extra, shall we say, package to add to her shame.
